verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's docs list a first-party Mission Control Agent and Mission Control MCP server for investigating your environment and making supported changes. This implies natural-language operation of the platform, but it rests on a single one-line mention, and changes are limited to 'supported' ones. The rest of the pack covers Console, Terraform, API and kubectl interfaces, not natural-language control. Missing for 10: documentation of the natural-language command interface and its scope of operations (e.g., clusters, node pools, storage), detail on which changes are supported, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
